summary.en: Iraqi security forces have deployed troops to the Kataib Hezbollah strongholds of Jurf al-Sakhar and Jurf al-Nasr while Prime Minister Al-Zaidi ordered an inquiry into oil smuggling and threatened force to enforce a militia withdrawal deadline. Kataib Hezbollah denied involvement in the smuggling probe, calling it a lie and accusing the government of yielding to external pressure. Jordan and Iraq jointly blocked the Telegram messaging app over national security and regulatory concerns, and five people were arrested for impersonating a prosecutor. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
